payload.core_mechanism_summary: Prefix frequency array to check in O(1) if any number lies in the gap (md - d + k, md-1] for each multiple md of candidate gcd d.
payload.rationale: The solution checks candidate gcd values exhaustively with range emptiness tests using cumulative counts. No DP state or optimal substructure; closest DP subtype is counting combinatorics due to frequency aggregation.
